name: Dataplex Universal Catalog (now Knowledge Catalog)
sku: The governance service documented as Dataplex Universal Catalog and renamed Knowledge Catalog on 10 April 2026. The record ID keeps the old name because IDs are immutable.

bands.note: A Gemini-powered catalog for the whole data estate: automatic metadata collection, semantic search for discovery, enrichment of technical metadata and business glossaries.
Data lineage tracks how data moves and transforms across systems.
Automated data profiling and quality checks.
Data governance with automatic metadata collection and policy enforcement across the estate.

presentation.tagline: Catalog, lineage, quality checks and policy across Google Cloud data.
